policies.title: Access profiles
policies.intro: Optional. Controls which devices and server ports a device can reach over the VPN. Devices without a profile reach only the server (and the internet, if enabled); access between devices is opened with a profile.
policies.empty_text: For example, a “Media viewer” profile could allow only port 8096 (Jellyfin). Rules apply automatically once devices are assigned to the profile.
policies.unassigned: Not assigned to any device. Assign it with “Edit” on the Devices tab.
policies.delete_blocked: First move the devices in this profile to another profile or to “no profile”.
policies.no_rules: No rules: a device with this profile cannot reach anything (only internet access is handled separately).

f.name: Profile name
f.groups_hint: Separate with commas. Devices in these groups that have no profile of their own use this profile automatically; a profile you assign to a device by hand takes precedence. A group can be the default of only one profile.
f.rules_hint: A device with this profile can reach only what is listed here; everything else is blocked on the server.
f.no_rules_edit: No rules. Pick a ready-made port below or add a blank rule.
f.sched_example: E.g. let a child’s device reach the game port on weekdays between 16:00 and 21:00.
f.sched_hint: This permission applies only during these hours; outside them the rule is treated as absent. Times are server time.
f.both_hint: Let that device reach me on the same ports too.

reach.title: Access test
reach.intro: Checks the rules to tell whether a connection would pass; it does not send any real packet.

how.title: How it works
how.allowlist: A device with a profile reaches only what its rules list; everything else is blocked on the server.
how.directed: Allowing A→B does not allow B→A; tick “Both ways” if you want that.
how.time: If you give a rule a time window, the permission is open only during those hours; the firewall updates itself at the boundary.
how.group: If you give a profile a default group, every new device added to that group starts out restricted.
how.internet: Internet access is separate from the profile and set per device.
how.panel: Devices with a profile reach the panel port ({port}) only if a rule allows it.
